title: Truncation factorization of the hypercohomology left edge
statement: Let B be Grothendieck abelian and C abelian with derived categories and G additive left exact. Let K ∈ D⁺(B) be GE 0 and LE n for n ∈ ℕ. Put i : τ_{<n+1}K → K, p : τ_{<n+1}K → τ_{≥n}τ_{<n+1}K, ε : τ_{≥n}τ_{<n+1}K ≅ (H^n K)[n], and f = i⁻¹ p ε. The hypercohomology spectral left edge followed by its coefficient target isomorphism [def-pc-hypercohomology-left-edge] equals H^n(RG(f)) followed by the shifted degree-zero comparison [def-pc-right-derived-single-degree-comparison].

source.place: Proof, remark (1), and single-complex specialization; canonical comparison elaborated by A3.

proof.text: Since K is LE n, i is an isomorphism, hence so is j = τ_{≥n}(i). Naturality of the GE projection gives π_K j⁻¹ = i⁻¹ p. The source-library leftEdge definition is H^n(RG π_K) followed by the inverse of H^n(RG j). Functors preserve inverses, so this is H^n(RG(i⁻¹ p)).

Expand the target isomorphism. Its first factor is H^n(RG ε), and its remaining factors are exactly the shifted degree-zero comparison. Functoriality and associativity yield the displayed factorization. This step is fully proved in Lean.

proof_origin.note: A3 expansion of the canonical single-complex calculation, using the concrete library isomorphisms. The truncation factorization is proved in Lean; the derived-unit normalization remains to be proved.

theorem hypercohomologyLeftEdge_truncation (K : DerivedCategory.Plus B) (n : ℕ)
    [DerivedCategory.Plus.TStructure.t.IsGE K 0]
    [DerivedCategory.Plus.TStructure.t.IsLE K n] :
    let t := DerivedCategory.Plus.TStructure.t (C := B)
    letI : IsIso ((t.truncLTι (n + 1)).app K) :=
      (t.isLE_iff_isIso_truncLTι_app (n : ℤ) (n + 1) rfl K).mp inferInstance
    let f := CategoryTheory.inv ((t.truncLTι (n + 1)).app K) ≫
      (t.truncGEπ n).app ((t.truncLT (n + 1)).obj K) ≫
      (DerivedCategory.Plus.eTruncLTCompETruncGEIso (n : ℤ)).hom.app K
    (G.hypercohomologySpectralObjectFunctor.obj K).leftEdge n ≫
        (G.hypercohomologyLeftEdgeTargetIso n).hom.app K =
      (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor C n).map (G.rightDerivedFunctorPlus.map f) ≫
        (G.rightDerivedSingleDegreeComparison n).hom.app
          ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor B n).obj K)
